name: tracedecay_context_relevance_eval
description: Labeled relevance eval for tracedecay_context against the frozen fixture project tests/fixtures/context_eval_project/. Each case is a natural-language task phrased like real usage. `relevant` is the allowed set of qualified names that count as a hit within the top 5 ContextResultV1.search_matches (recall@5). `required_top3` is a subset of `relevant` that must appear within the top 3 of that ranking (anchor hit rate). Metrics are recomputed by the test from the live tracedecay_context output, so a fixture whose expected metrics disagree with its own cases fails loudly. Ranking is lexical search_matches because context races search against the verified graph without waiting (`race_primary_search_with_graph(..., false)`); the former entry_points field is gone.

cases.note: known ranking gap under ContextResultV1.search_matches (search-graph independence; former entry_points ranking is gone): lexical top-3 is the retry module re-export and unrelated session/config symbols, not retry_with_backoff.
